An '''[[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]''' was used by [[Captain]] [[Slavin]] of the [[Imperial Navy]]<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Chronology Note" /> Slavin brought the [[Star Destroyer]] to the [[Tonnis sector]] to rendezvous with [[Freighter 2716]], which was [[transport]]ing a giant [[kyber crystal]] from the [[Jedha system]]. The Star Destroyer, along with with the [[freighter]] were destroyed when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Saw Gerrera]] [[Mission to Faos Station|destabilized]] the [[crystal]] in an attempt to stop the [[Galactic Empire]] from weaponizing the crystal.<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />
